in_marathi.name: Pandurang
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's servant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pandurang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pandurang is a combination of two words - 'Pandu' and 'Rang'. 'Pandu' means 'dark' and 'Rang' means 'servant'. This name signifies Lord Vishnu as the servant of his devotees. In Hindu mythology, Pandurang is a form of Lord Vishnu, who is believed to protect his devotees from all dangers.
